Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (May 18, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Tender, Ariba Document Number 3948833589, Contract Number 23ECS-RD-08SP. Description: Reconstruction of Toronto Transit Commission track allowance and partial reconstruction of roadway and sidewalk on Broadview Avenue from Gerrard Street East to Danforth Avenue. Recommended Supplier: Sanscon Construction Limited Contract Award Value: $6,417,185 net of all applicable taxes and charges $7,251,419 including HST and all applicable charges $6,530,127 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award and end on March 31, 2024.
